metadata.method: Serial Node-observed round trips through a test-only Worker and one SQLite-backed Durable Object. Includes transport, JSON, validation, filtering, all searches, proof replay and response. Fixture construction, Node parity assertions and independent post-call verification excluded. Worker performance.now samples reported separately; may be frozen during synchronous work. No CPU or peak-memory metric. No forced GC; no production traffic, storage writes or scheduling.
